escape_rule: escape_epoch is the first epoch beginning a run of 3 consecutive epochs with val_pred_sd_ratio > 0.05, the wave-5 rule verbatim. escape_sustained is whether the LAST three epochs of the run are also above it, which is what separates an escape that held from job 1678's escape-then-collapse.
scoring_note: test_spearman_pinned is read at the validation-selected epoch, never as a maximum over epochs. The 019 replicate study puts the between-seed spread near 0.04 in Pearson, so a paired difference under that is within noise at one seed. Draw fractions carry their tolerances in the same record.
